headline: The Fundamental Distinction Between Database Template Matching and AI Geometric Generation in Apparel
description: This article provides a technical framework to distinguish between database template matching and true geometric generation in apparel platforms, explaining why the term 'AI Customization' conflates two different engineering operations.
keywords: AI Customization, Database Template Matching, Geometric Generation, Nonlinear Mapping, SAR Index, AETERNAL, apparel engineering, computational pattern generation
